name: 發布前改選 LINE 群組與發布群組只讀存取
requiresDatabases: central_archive.meeting_workspaces (existing; add publication route guard trigger)
definitionOfDone: Host selects a verified same-OA same-tenant group before publication
Selection preserves the source recording, Notion database, editors, task IDs, owners and dates
Destination has independent version checks and an attributed audit record
Group save sends no LINE and preserves unsaved content
Published destination members can read and play audio without draft or write privileges
Destination membership, bot identity and tenant changes revoke access
Publishing freezes the recipient, message text and original retry key
Exact production code and existing business data are verified before Deployed status
Database protection prevents legacy workers and older clients from sending a new destination publication to the original source
